claim_boundary: Exact finite rational evidence for symmetric semantic-bit adjudication after a refuting atom has already been located. No real-judge, refutation-search, superhuman-work, or ASMP-resolution claim.
family_counts: for each q: sorted unique of {1,min(3,q),q}
stop_rule: Run once after registration. Any failed implementation/control gate invalidates the instrument; any failed directional gate is reported without amendment.
